services.name: Tandem Groups
services.desc: Ok. We know what you’re thinking, of course they’re going to pitch us getting the tandem skydiving video for my tandem skydive. Well, you’re right, but maybe you can give us a chance to tell you why it’s worth it. Unfortunately, the short answer is no. It is a hard no because of safety. Here at Skydive Chicago, you aren’t a passive passenger going for a ride. We ask you to be an active participant on the jump - hence we call you a tandem ‘student,’ and given objectives for your experience. Skydiving is an extreme and dangerous sport. services.desc: Every skydiving center has its own unique set of rules and guidelines that differ from drop zone to drop zone. SDC Rhythm XP is our 4-way RW team dedicated to becoming the top team in the world while helping other skydivers develop their skills and grow their love of the sport. SDC Rhythm XP offers wind tunnel coaching and workshops, player-coach team training, and full team coaching. They organize at SDC Summerfest as well as host events at Skydive Chicago.
